EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The indenting bidder should be of either Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd, M/s Shanthi Gears , M/s Elecon Engineering Company Ltd or its authourised dealers having successfully executed the work of Refurbishing the Gearbox in any Central/State Government Owned Thermal power plant or any Public/Private sector in any of the last preceding five years i.e. 2025-26 ,2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 & 2021-22 and in proof of this Job/ Work Orders of value(Not more than two) not less than Rs 42.50 Lakhs has to be furnished.

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 85.0 Lakhs in any two financial years in the preceding five financial years i.e. 2025-26 ,2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 & 2021-22. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement duly certified by a chartered accountant indicating UDIN No on his letter head. Weightage at 10% per year will be given for the turn overvalue to bring to the current financial year in which the tender has been invited.
